title: A02: salvage before paying to regenerate
summary: A02 contains 227 original videos. The filename inventory has 26 LETTER clips, 26 NATO clips, 31 NUM clips and 144 other clips. The existing recovery package plans 83 readback-candidate jobs but performs no live ASR or dispatch.
invariants: Filename categories are *hints*, not proof of spoken content.
Do not expand numerical filenames into assumed pronunciation.
83 recovery definitions = 26 + 26 + 31; the 227 videos do not imply 227 verified word-level transcripts.
Work definitions hold SHA-256-pinned video and extracted-audio references.
Extra improvisational material marks a proposed word interval contaminated until reviewed, rather than making the whole interval accepted.
Recovered source intervals are never approved automatically, even on exact transcript match.
procedure: Bind each source to a Storage Fabric pinned object/revision.
Obtain independent transcript with per-word offsets and source identity.
Locate candidate intervals and preserve neighbour/contamination evidence.
Review lip motion, source video PTS and audio by a human.
Reuse approved extracts, and generate only missing/unusable items.

provenance.claim: 83 source-pinned legacy recovery definitions and review-only candidate policy.
Readback six-utterance generation plan, script matching and review limits.
